title: Research material: reference photo and AI-generated outputs
caption: Source Figure 1 uses prompts based on Kristi Noem’s characteristics. The left column repeats a real reference photograph. All fifteen images to its right are AI-generated research stimuli, arranged by generator and the attribute omitted from the prompt. They are not authentic portraits of Noem. Names were excluded from the generation prompts; the gallery is an example, not an estimate of an average effect.
alt: Source-paper comparison with a real reference photograph on the left and clearly identified AI-generated research outputs across three models and five masking conditions.
credit: Caliskan et al., The Imagined Congress, public SSRN manuscript, Figure 1.

title: Full information does not ensure a faithful distribution
caption: Source Figure 8 compares verified sample characteristics with the facial-analysis pipeline’s estimates for full-information (“Benchmark”) and masked-prompt (“Treatment”) portraits. The age distributions show a large youth shift even in the benchmark. Gender and race panels use the paper’s simplified binary categories; they summarize model classifications rather than identities.
alt: Original three-panel comparison of generated and verified age distributions, gender-category shares and race-category shares.
credit: Caliskan et al., The Imagined Congress, public SSRN manuscript, Figure 8.

title: Masking effects vary by platform and condition
caption: Source Figure 13 analyzes legislators recorded as women. The bottom panel compares masked prompts with the same politicians’ full-information prompts; negative treatment coefficients mean fewer woman-coded outputs. The Stable Diffusion differential is a comparison with the other platforms, not its complete effect. Its direction varies by condition, so the plot does not establish a universal benefit or harm from curation.
alt: Three coefficient panels with 95 percent confidence intervals for gender-classification changes among women legislators under different masking conditions and platform comparisons.
credit: Caliskan et al., The Imagined Congress, public SSRN manuscript, Figure 13.
